source: Fixed product copy written by the project: two fields per canonical assertion ID in evaluation/assertion_definitions.json (policy-v1.3). Never generated at runtime and never taken from model output. "failure" says what a FAIL of that assertion means (FAIL lines and the briefing); "description" says what the check verifies (tiles of any status). The policy's formal definition stays in evaluation/assertion_definitions.json.

fit.coverage_complete.failure: predictions are not exactly one per fold, or are not traceable to their producing step
fit.coverage_complete.description: Each fold has exactly one set of predictions, traced back through every recorded supported step on its path

fit.state_dependencies_within_fold_train.failure: a preprocessing or model step was fit on rows outside its fold's training data
fit.state_dependencies_within_fold_train.description: Every recorded preprocessing and model step used in a fold learned only from that fold's training rows

metric.prediction_ids_match_eval_ids.failure: the predictions do not cover exactly the rows each fold was meant to evaluate
metric.prediction_ids_match_eval_ids.description: Predictions cover exactly the test rows declared for each fold

metric.reported_matches_recomputed.failure: the reported metric does not match the metric ATLAS recomputed
metric.reported_matches_recomputed.description: The score the project reports matches the score ATLAS recomputes from its predictions, within tolerance

split.evaluation_folds_nonempty.failure: a declared evaluation fold contains no evaluation rows
split.evaluation_folds_nonempty.description: Every test fold contains at least one row to evaluate

split.no_group_overlap.failure: the same groups (such as people) appear in both training and testing within a fold
split.no_group_overlap.description: No group, such as a person, appears in both training and testing within a fold

split.no_row_overlap.failure: the same rows appear in both training and testing within a fold
split.no_row_overlap.description: No data row appears in both training and testing within a fold

split.no_shared_source_observation.failure: the same source observation appears in both training and testing within a fold
split.no_shared_source_observation.description: No test row is the same original observation as a training row

split.no_window_overlap.failure: a training time window overlaps an evaluation window in the same stream
split.no_window_overlap.description: Time windows used for training and testing do not overlap within the same recording stream

split.repeated_measures_rule.failure: repeated measurements of a unit (or its containing group) appear on both sides of a fold's split
split.repeated_measures_rule.description: Within each fold, repeated measurements of a unit (or its containing group) are not split between training and testing

split.sampling_unit_disjoint.failure: the same declared sampling units (such as participants) appear on both sides of a fold's split
split.sampling_unit_disjoint.description: Each declared sampling unit, such as a participant, stays on one side of the split

split.temporal_separation.failure: training and evaluation items are closer in time than the declared minimum gap
split.temporal_separation.description: Within each fold, every training item and test item are at least the declared minimum time gap apart

temporal.cutoff_precedes_evaluation.failure: the declared gap is negative, or the training cutoff plus the declared gap comes after the earliest test prediction time
temporal.cutoff_precedes_evaluation.description: In each fold, the training cutoff plus the declared gap comes no later than the earliest test prediction time

temporal.features_available_when_used.failure: a feature value was used before the time it became available
temporal.features_available_when_used.description: Every feature value used for a row was available by that row's prediction time

temporal.training_labels_available_by_cu.failure: a training row or its label is dated after the training cutoff
temporal.training_labels_available_by_cu.description: Every training row, and its label, is dated no later than its fold's training cutoff
